q: Why do some people wear perfume?
a: I suppose some people wear perfume because it makes them feel more confident in public places. They also feel that wearing perfume can make themselves more attractive.

vocab: 把额头上的头发翻上去的发型，“背头”
用发胶（hair spray）把头发竖起来的发型
把脑后的头发扎成球形的发型，“发髻”

q: Do you prefer old buildings or new buildings?
a:
I prefer old buildings because they look more attractive. New buildings tend to look the same or very similar. I would say many of them lack character.

或者：
I prefer new buildings because they are safer and easier to maintain. Old buildings look attractive but they're not as safe as new buildings. And they are usually expensive to maintain.
vocab: 更安全而且更容易维护

q: Do you think old buildings are important?
a: Yes, they're really important because they show us how people lived in the past and help us better understand our history and culture. Many old buildings are also famous landmarks. They attract tourists and contribute to the economy.
vocab: better understand our history and culture
更好地了解我们的历史和文化

q: What types of museums can be found in your country?
a: A variety of museums can be found in my country, such as history museums, science and technology museums and art museums. Children's museums can also be found in some cities.
Yes, I do because their exhibitions are a good source of knowledge and information. Many museums also offer hands-on activities that are interesting and enjoyable.
vocab: a good source of knowledge and information
很好的知识和信息的来源（knowledge 和 information 都不能加 s）
提供让参观者们亲身参与的活动

q: Do you think museums are important?
a: Yes, they're very important because they help us gain knowledge about history, culture, technology and many other aspects of life. They also offer many hands-on activities that are fun and relaxing.
vocab: 让参观者们亲身参与的活动
适合各个年龄段的人们

q: Do you think it's a good idea for museums to sell souvenirs?
a: Yes, I suppose it's a good idea because the souvenirs can help visitors better understand the exhibitions. And museums can use the profit from their gift shops to increase their collections.
vocab: help visitors better understand the exhibitions
帮助参观者们更好地理解展览
（博物馆或者旅游景点的）礼品店

q: Do you think libraries are important?
a: Definitely. Libraries offer a wide variety of books, which are a good source of knowledge and information.
vocab: 绝对是这样（语气很强，只适合想表达强烈肯定态度的考题）
a good source of knowledge and information
很好的知识与信息的来源

q: How often do you stay in hotels?
a: At least a few times a year. I usually stay in hotels when I travel.

q: What are the advantages of staying in a hotel?
a: The main advantage is hotels offer safe and convenient accommodation. Many hotels also offer a variety of amenities, such as restaurants and swimming pools.

q: Do you think it's important to be polite to others?
a: Yes, it's important because being polite is a virtue. It shows that we have respect for others. It also shows that we're thoughtful and responsible.
vocab: 关心别人的，替别人着想的
make a good impression on others
按提前约好的时间到达
avoid talking loudly in public places
避免在公共场所大声喧哗
use “please” when you ask for help
